NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of notice: 2026-08-16
Member: Rowan Novak
Member ID: W671638429
Plan: Healthy Blue Louisiana (Commercial/ACA), state of Louisiana

Dear Rowan,

We reviewed the prior authorization request submitted by your provider for the following service:

    Requested service: Partial knee replacement
    Procedure code (CPT): 27446

After review, this request is DENIED. Reason for determination: the clinical records submitted do not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment prior to the requested surgery.

This determination was made under the plan's applicable medical policy and clinical review criteria. You have the right to appeal this decision. Your appeal must be received within 180 days of the date of this notice (by 2027-02-12).

Reference number: POC-7CD7D16B79-75735


---

If no such document is publicly available, say so explicitly and explain how
